metadata.description: Claude Code mods built for a solo creator's daily workflow.

plugins.name: credit-meter
plugins.description: ElevenLabs characters and Higgsfield credits in a pane, with a toast before and after a tool call spends them.

plugins.name: youtube-pulse
plugins.description: Your channel's latest videos and view counts, with the gain since you last looked.

plugins.name: routine-watch
plugins.description: A dashboard for scheduled routines that write to a Notion database: today's haul, the last 7 days, quiet sources and next runs.

plugins.name: publish-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Claude from typing or writing your private terms into the browser or your publishing files.

plugins.name: record-mode
plugins.description: /record on masks emails, phone numbers, money and your own terms on screen while you record.
